text:
Mia: tiny ask before bed: drop one comfort album and one short tv episode (or single short film) that makes you feel weirdly soothed. no long essays.
Jonah: album: 'Moon Safari' - Air. short film: 'La Jetee' (25min).
Priya: album: 'For Emma, Forever Ago' - Bon Iver. episode: the 'San Junipero' Black Mirror episode (standalone and warm).
Carlos: album: 'Music for Airports' - Brian Eno. short film: 'The Red Balloon' (childhood nostalgia hit).
Mia: these are perfect. bonus: any 1-panel comics or zines to tuck under the pillow?
Jonah: 1-panel: 'xkcd' is peak late-night cartooning. simple and oddly comforting.
Priya: tiny zine rec: 'Notes on a Triangle' (short poetry zine). fits on a bedside coaster.
atlas-bot: created collaborative quicklist 'Night Comforts' and added: Air - 'Moon Safari', Brian Eno - 'Music for Airports', Bon Iver - 'For Emma, Forever Ago'. link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5example :robot_face:
Carlos: meme: "me at 11:58pm promising myself one episode and then rewatching three seasons" :grimacing:
Mia: pact: try one new rec and report back with one sentence tomorrow. night team. :crescent_moon:
